subject: financial_literacy
concept: Understanding mutual funds and index funds as ways to invest in many companies at once
source_inspiration: original content, connecting to the P6 diversification concept — not sourced from any external text

exercise.concrete: Student builds a simulated fund by combining several small pieces of different companies into one basket
exercise.pictorial: Student matches an index fund to the broad market segment it tracks
exercise.abstract: Student explains how a mutual or index fund provides diversification compared to buying a single stock

misconception_flags: believes an index fund still carries the same single-company risk as buying one individual stock

interest_binding: exercise regenerated using student's stated interest profile
